messages:
Nina C: spotted a tar.gz in partner bucket with Vault sealed blobs: s3://partner-export/redwood/2026-03-22-sealed-export.tar.gz
Raj P: can you share object metadata & which KMS key was used to wrap?
Nina C: uploader=partner-sync-sa@partner-prod; key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner-kr/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap (HSM). crc32: 7f3b2a
oncall-bot: ALERT: sealed-blob-detect triggered for partner-sync-sa (rule: sealed-blob-in-external-bucket)
Omar L: immediate actions: 1) copy to sec-quarantine 2) snapshot KMS IAM and audit logs 3) revoke decrypt from partner SA 4) start token accessor sweep. I'll take 1-3.
Nina C: running: `aws s3 cp s3://partner-export/redwood/2026-03-22-sealed-export.tar.gz s3://sec-quarantine/partner-2026-03-22-sealed-export.tar.gz` 
Raj P: save IAM: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy partner-wrap --location=global --keyring=partner-kr > /tmp/partner-policy-before.json`
Omar L: removing binding now: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding partner-wrap --location=global --keyring=partner-kr --member="serviceAccount:partner-sync-sa@partner-prod" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"`
partner-ops: partner confirms this was an automated export from staging; they will pause the job and provide context.
Nina C: quarantine copy done; saved IAM to gs://ops/audit/partner-policy-before.json; logs show SA was granted decrypt by onboarding job 2 days ago.
Raj P: open incident INC-2026-058 and notify Legal. we should plan: rotate wrap key version, canary rewrap, token sweep, onboarding CI gate.
Omar L: enabling Vault audit for affected namespace and exporting last 30 days of KMS key usage to BigQuery.
Nina C: starting token sweep: `vault token revoke -accessor=<accessor>` for accessors tied to partner activity.
partner-ops: partner says no external access detected; they will share retention policy for these exports.
Raj P: create new key version and do a canary rewrap for 25 objects; validate restores before full rewrap. Leah (infra) should add gating to onboarding PR.
Omar L: canary started. 25 objects rewrapped and 23 validated; two failures due to path naming mismatch, fixing job.
Nina C: postmortem scheduled 2026-03-23 09:30. remediation items: block direct cryptoKeyDecrypter grants in onboarding, require codeowner review, add alert for sealed-blob uploads to external buckets, bump Vault audit retention to 90d.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-058 (severity: medium) assigned to Nina C and Omar L
Raj P: thanks team. moving follow-ups to INC ticket. closing Slack thread to reduce noise. :white_check_mark:
